name: pg_triggers_oversight_findtriggerincompatiblewithinheritance
subject: Fix oversight in FindTriggerIncompatibleWithInheritance.
goal:
A statement-level trigger with transition tables can wrongly prevent a former partition or inheritance child from being attached or inherited again. Such a trigger does not have the row-level incompatibility that the check is intended to catch.

On a table hierarchy with statement triggers referencing transition tables, detach and reattach a partition, then repeat the analogous NO INHERIT and INHERIT sequence. Both round trips must succeed. Trigger kinds that are genuinely incompatible with inheritance must still be rejected, and row-level trigger behavior must remain unchanged.
